design.alternative: extend decision registration with episode roster
design.reason: Whole tasks are a separate measurement unit and do not require a reviewed decision corpus.
design.reviewFix: Require the same manager model and prompt in both arms.

delegation.isolation: Separate temporary design artifacts; one owner for four code/test files; parent owns docs and final verification.
delegation.commentReview: clean; no comments or suppressions found

limits: All verification inputs are synthetic. No live outcomes or independent real-world reviews were gathered.
Bootstrap intervals are exploratory, not calibrated coverage guarantees.
Source digests and imported attestations do not authenticate execution, identity, independence, or chronology.
Cross-protocol calibration/holdout task separation requires review of the retained rosters.
Live outcome instrumentation, reviewed datasets, actual calibration, and paid qualification campaigns remain outstanding.
Decision-level uncertainty and unsafe-versus-ineffective labels remain separate work.
